meta.note: The CAA says most airports and airfields have a flight restriction zone (FRZ), where you need the site's permission to fly. This circle is 2 nautical miles (3.7 km), the CAA's size for an FRZ with no aerodrome traffic zone and for the smallest one. It is only a guide: real zones can be 2.5 nautical miles, add 1 km wide strips reaching 5 km from each runway end, and extend 1 km past the airfield boundary. Some unlicensed airfields have no FRZ but are still dangerous to fly near. Heliports are not shown. Check the UK AIP before you fly.
